# RoboTwin collection/evaluation runtime.  Description-generation SDKs are
# intentionally excluded: the flow only consumes the checked-in instructions.
# TOPPRA ships a NumPy-1.x ABI extension, so NumPy 2 is incompatible.
# huggingface-hub must satisfy lerobot 0.4.4 (>=0.34.2) and diffusers 0.35.2
# (>=0.34.0). An older hub (e.g. 0.25.0) breaks the evaluation import chain
# with `ImportError: cannot import name 'DDUFEntry' from 'huggingface_hub'`
# exactly when the flow reaches the eval stage, after a full training run.
# 0.35.3 matches the `emix` training environment.
huggingface-hub==0.35.3
-r requirements-sapien.txt
toppra==0.6.7
warp-lang==1.12.0
# Curobo v0.7.8 is built with --no-deps so it cannot replace CUDA PyTorch;
# install its remaining runtime/build requirements explicitly here.
importlib-resources==7.1.0
numpy-quaternion==2024.0.13
pybind11==3.1.0
scikit-image==0.24.0
setuptools-scm==10.3.4
yourdfpy==0.0.60
transforms3d==0.4.2
scipy==1.10.1
mplib==0.2.1
gymnasium==0.29.1
trimesh==4.4.3
open3d==0.18.0
imageio==2.34.2
pydantic
zarr
h5py
pyglet<2
moviepy
termcolor
av
matplotlib
ffmpeg
